# Gameswelt — Wanadoo’s Games Convention plans

- Original source: [Wanadoo auf der Games Convention](https://www.gameswelt.de/wanadoo/news/ein-weiterer-publisher-in-leipzig-vertreten-68056)
- Author / publication: Andreas Philipp; Gameswelt.
- Language / date: German; 2002-07-30.
- Access: Complete short news item inspected through indexed text.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The announcement places Robin Hood among Wanadoo’s main attractions at the Leipzig Games Convention, alongside Haegemonia, Ironstorm, and Project Zero. It identifies the public stand as F03 in Hall 3 and describes separate meetings for press and business partners.

This supplies a dated lead for locating contemporary show reports, photographs, or playable-build impressions. The announcement covers Wanadoo’s overall PC and console presence; it does not announce a console version of this Robin Hood game or confirm what visitors ultimately played.
